proposals.evidence: DEDR 5086 gives Kannada mēle ‘above, top’ and explicitly distinguishes Maria Gondi mēlo ‘bad’ from Koya mēlta ‘good’ and mēlo ‘taboo’ in another source. The Bhamani Madia survey’s melo ‘bad’ follows the Maria attestation; its meaning is preserved rather than inferred from the opposite Koya sense.
